prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create one simple modern neighborhood streetlamp game sprite.
Input1 (bench) is the color/ink/material reference; Input2 (school) is the shallow straight-on RPG camera reference.
Object: one slim dark muted gray-brown pole, a short simple sturdy circular base, topped by one small rounded lamp head with a soft opaque cream glass enclosure and a simple gray-brown cap. Restrained contemporary small Korean neighborhood design. Clean vertical pole and horizontal cap, no ornate European lantern, no curls, no finials, no double arms. Lamp is off in daylight; no emitted glow. Head at most 1/4.5 total height in width; overall complete object's width:height roughly1:4.5. Keep a compact understated head with one cream glass panel, not detailed metal lattice.
Matte muted colors, warm clean brown outlines, gentle broad shaded planes, no grain/noise, no glossy 3D. Direct frontal orthographic view with very shallow top surface visible, no isometric angle and no perspective lean.
Single full object isolated on genuine transparent RGBA background; tightly composed but leave safe margin. No checkerboard image, no ground tile, no cast shadow, no plants, no additional props, no labels.
correctionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve this simple streetlamp's exact head, base, muted gray-brown palette, brown outline and straight front view. Make ONLY these two corrections:
1) Shorten the long straight shaft by 45 percent (remove almost half its height); the full lamp including head and base should now be about 4.3 times taller than its width. The head/base width and their proportions do not change. Do not make the head smaller or narrower. This will read better as a small cozy RPG streetlamp.
2) Replace the entire checkerboard background with perfectly flat solid saturated magenta #FF00FF for chroma key extraction. No checker pattern, no gradient, no floor, no shadow. Outside the lamp every pixel is pure magenta.
Keep the whole completed object with safe margin. No other objects, text or decorative details.
processing: Magenta key, alpha-bounds crop with 2px margin and bicubic resize to256px height. No creative script image editing.
